title: Veil of the Reaper
description: A hooded skeletal figure with glowing purple eyes and ornate red hood stands behind a young woman with blue and orange face paint. The woman has a somber expression with blue tears dripping down her face while the skeleton's bony hand rests on her shoulder.
prompt: A haunting dark fantasy scene featuring a hooded skeletal grim reaper with glowing purple eyes and intricate red cloak standing behind a young woman. The woman has blue and orange painted face with long blue tears streaming down, wearing a decorative headpiece with lotus motifs. The skeleton's bony hand rests on her shoulder against a swirling background of ancient symbols and runes, dramatic lighting, rich textures and dripping paint effects.
